_voted_data_note: No 25th Knesset voting data available. Yoaz Hendel (party leader) was not an MK in the 25th Knesset. His earlier voting record from the 23rd Knesset (Blue and White, faction 969) and 24th Knesset aligns with the national_unity data in this dataset. stated_position.source: Party settlement initiative ('המילואימניקים מתייצבים להתיישבות!'): actively promoting settlement nuclei in Golan, Galilee, Jordan Valley, Negev, Gaza Envelope; party objectives include 'advancing Zionist values including settlements'; leadership includes CEO of Samaria Regional Council and settlers from Eli and Kfar Tapuach

Hendel characterizes conflict as 'clash of civilizations' where 'peace is unlikely without change that will take generations'; dismissed diplomatic engagement as a mistake that contributed to October 7; shifted rightward post-Oct 7 advocating territorial control in Lebanon and Gaza

Party platform: 'Israel should adopt an aggressive security policy that moves the decision to enemy territory — from containment to initiative and offensiveness'; Hendel supports expanded Israeli presence in Gaza post-conflict and controlling northern Gaza
Hendel stated 'united Jerusalem is our fiction' (ירושלים המאוחדת שלנו היא בדיון); pragmatic-nationalist approach rather than maximalist permanent sovereignty claim
Opposes right of return

Hendel at Herzliya Conference 2013: proposed annexing settlement blocs and the Jordan Valley (granting citizenship to Arab residents); party's settlement initiative actively promotes settlement in Jordan Valley and Gaza Envelope post-war
CORE PLATFORM: universal military/national service for all citizens — Haredim, Arabs, and secular alike. Party was founded on this principle by reserve officers
Hendel is secular; supports civil marriage
Supports Shabbat commerce freedom
Supports religious pluralism at Western Wall
Strongly opposes unconditional yeshiva funding — directly tied to party's core conscription stance
Opposes state kashrut enforcement
Neutral on privatization
Hendel as Blue & White MK strongly opposed override clause; consistent position
Opposes political takeover of judiciary appointments
Supports AG authority as rule-of-law safeguard
Supports judicial review including reasonableness standard
Strongly supports judicial independence; part of opposition coalition against judicial reform
Supports equality for all citizens who fulfil civic obligations (service)

Party explicitly calls for 'Zionist unity government' excluding Arab AND Haredi parties; Hendel stated 'I will not sit with Haredim and Arabs, only with Zionist parties' — this is a foundational and unambiguous platform principle
Supports equal municipal services; conscription service as path to full civic equality
Neutral on Nation-State Law; not a party focus
Supports PM accountability; part of pro-rule-of-law bloc
Supports term limits for PM
Mid-sized party; would benefit from higher threshold eliminating smaller fringe parties
Reserve officers overwhelmingly demand inquiry — it is a core party motivation
Educated, capable workforce essential for military service — core curriculum is a prerequisite
Supports professional media standards and preventing systematic disinformation
No public stance on gender parity in electoral lists found
New party with no detailed climate platform; centrist positioning implies openness to OECD-aligned legislation
